name: Turntable Negative
description: Catppuccin Mocha recolour of Turntable with inverted duotone cover art and a deliberately quiet interface: no video shelves, no browse artwork, no colour noise.

name: Duotone Covers
description: Renders album and playlist artwork as a two-colour duotone; the original cover returns on hover. One feColorMatrix, pure CSS from there on.

name: Hide Videos
description: Hides video podcast episodes and their shelves, plus the 'Similar music videos' section in the Now Playing view. Mixed shelves keep their non-video cards.

name: Home Lazy Shelves
description: Renders only the top home shelves and defers the rest until you scroll near them. Measured 45% less style and layout work per recalculation.

name: Browse Calm Cards
description: Strips the 27 loud colours and the tilted artwork from the 'Browse all' category tiles. Neutral surfaces, accent colour only on hover.

name: NPV Collapse
description: Hides the right sidebar while it only shows the Now Playing view. Show the queue or devices and it returns at full width. Pure CSS via :has().

name: Playbar Track Options
description: Puts the current track's context menu button in the player bar, so it stays reachable with the right sidebar hidden. Right-click toggles the Now Playing view.

name: Accent Fixups
description: Removes the leftover Spotify green from Encore button states, pins the home header to the theme colour and aligns a few stray icons. Companion to the Turntable Negative palette.
